name: TotalSegmentator2D v2
runtime: Official ts2d 1.2.0 package in an isolated Python 3.12 / PyTorch 2.7.1+cu126 environment; local model database only
acceptance: The official composite key resolved and ran all five groups on sample_s0332.nrrd with remote access disabled, producing five nonempty group segmentations and a combined 117-channel segmentation.
blocker: TS2D collapses the CT anterior-posterior axis into a coronal intensity projection. The preserved-geometry result contains one AP voxel spanning the source depth and cannot recover voxelwise 3-D anatomy; RTSTRUCT conversion would therefore be geometrically false.
